articles.title: Oil falls after U.S. and Iran talk for hours at UN meeting
articles.description: Oil fell Wednesday, amid hopes of a diplomatic solution to the conflict in the Middle East after Iran and the U.S. had talks.

articles.title: AI potential to drive crypto demand remains ‘underappreciated’: BlackRock
articles.description: BlackRock says AI agents could drive demand for stablecoins and programmable payment rails, while tokenized computing capacity could create another opportunity for digital assets.

articles.title: Zcash leads crypto majors with a 10% gain as bitcoin holds near $87,000
articles.description: Falling oil eased inflation worries through the Asian session, while a bill to make the government's bitcoin stockpile permanent moved further through Congress than any before it.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic to brief UN Security Council on AI risks: Reports

articles.description: World leaders descended on New York for the annual United Nations General Assembly, where the agenda covers topics from wars to the risks posed by AI.

articles.title: South Korean solar stocks jump as curbs on Chinese sector expected to remain in place
articles.description: South Korean solar stocks jumped as U.S. restrictions on Chinese solar products came into focus ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.

articles.title: CFTC issues warning over risky prediction market ‘mention’ contracts

articles.title: Trump administration is examining whether a diesel export ban is feasible, Treasury Secretary says
articles.description: Republican lawmakers have called for an export ban as high diesel prices hit farmers and truckers ahead of the November midterm elections.

articles.title: Here's who we know is going to the Trump-Xi dinner so far

articles.description: The conglomerate built by Warren Buffett and led today by Greg Abel holds a sizable stake in Miami-based homebuilder Lennar.

articles.title: Trump discloses more than 1,100 July trades, including up to $25 million each in sales of Microsoft, Amazon

articles.title: Democrats 'chose visceral hatred for' Donald Trump over crypto Clarity Act, Lummis says

articles.title: Royal Caribbean nears $3 billion deal to take 50% equity stake in Sandals
articles.description: Royal Caribbean has been trying to diversify beyond cruises and become a leader overall in vacations.

articles.title: Trump administration removes around 760,000 Obamacare enrollments, alleging fraud
articles.description: Vice President JD Vance's White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud estimates the action will save roughly $2.2 billion in taxpayer-funded subsidies.

articles.title: Arch Lending eyes tokenized stocks as next collateral market

articles.title: Republican senator calls for probe into US presidents’ sons, citing crypto ventures
articles.description: Many Democrats have previously called for investigations into the Trump family’s crypto ventures, but now a Republican is asking for an inquiry based on ties to the presidency.
